message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current temperature or forecast for San Francisco right now. However, here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect:

| Time of Year | Typical High | Typical Low | Notes |
|--------------|--------------|-------------|-------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 55–60 °F (13–16 °C) | 45–50 °F (7–10 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog. |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 60–65 °F (16–18 °C) | 50–55 °F (10–13 °C) | Mild, less fog, rain possible. |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 65–70 °F (18–21 °C) | 55–60 °F (13–16 °C) | Warm, dry, but coastal breezes keep it comfortable. |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | 60–65 °F (16–18 °C) | 50–55 °F (10–13 °C) | Pleasant, decreasing rainfall. |

If you need the current conditions, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of a specific date or anything else!
